extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated from tissue using the Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen, Germantown, MD, USA) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
data_processing: Data were processed using Partek software. Gene level expression were summarized from the corrected intensities and then quantile normalized.
